messages:
Aisha (PM): Quick thread to finalize onboarding acceptance + migration incentives. I sketched 3 lanes: lite, standard, enterprise. Need hard gates for perf/quality/compat.
Mei (ML): Define lite = tiny-context use (<=128 tokens), fast infer optimized. Suggest p95 < 60ms for lite, standard p95 < 150ms, enterprise negotiated SLA.
Ben (SRE): FYI multi-tenant tail and context bump can push p95 up ~2x. If we promise <60ms we need strict context limit enforcement and separate pool.
Clara (CustomerOps): Customers care about pin durations and explicit rollback paths. Proposed pin defaults: lite 21d, standard 60d, enterprise custom. Also want standard migration assistance.
Javier (Product): Migration incentive idea: 15% credit + up to 6h of SE time for the first 20 customers who opt-in in Q3. Helps reduce pushback on 60d TTL.
Mei (ML): Quality gates: for standard lane require 200-sample intent eval with <=4% regression relative to baseline; hallucination failure rate <2% on NER checks; embedding parity: mean cosine drop <0.025.
Aisha (PM): Compatibility gate: quantized run pass + abi check for KV cache offsets and chunking. If either fails, model goes into "compat-canary" with traffic split and automatic fallback.
Ben (SRE): Implementation note: we need a tenant-pin-override flag + audit log. For extensions >14d require SRE approval. ops-bot: can we surface a 1-click playbook?
ops-bot: Playbook template exists in /playbooks/pin-extension. Procedure requires ticket, auto-compat-check, SRE approval if >14d.
Clara (CustomerOps): Communication playbook: 1) announce deprecation 45d prior for lite/standard, 90d for enterprise, 2) migration checklist + links, 3) opt-in for migrate-assist.
Javier (Product): Deprecation policy: soft-deprecate -> limited traffic routing -> complete retirement. Auto-fallback policy should prefer nearest-compatible family (same tokenizer + quantization).
Mei (ML): Extra eval: add a stability test across prompt paraphrases (50 paraphrases) and require intent variance <3 pts. Also regression on embedded-search MRR delta <0.02.
Ben (SRE): Note perf cost: compatibility shims (format adapters) add ~8-12% median latency and ~15% CPU overhead on host. Call this out in acceptance doc and in cost estimate for migration credits.
Aisha (PM): Decision needed today: accept lane thresholds? set TTLs? approve migration credit program? lock acceptance metrics?
Javier (Product): Vote: lanes + metrics as Mei proposed. Migration program approved 15% + 6h for early cohort.
Clara (CustomerOps): +1. I'll draft the external customer comms and FAQ.
Ben (SRE): +1 with caveat: enforce context limits for lite. I'll draft runbook.
Mei (ML): +1. I'll publish the eval harness and sample generator.
Aisha (PM): Actions: Javier update roadmap & budget; Mei publish eval checklist (due 2026-06-15); Ben write pin-extension runbook (due 2026-06-12); Clara draft migration outreach (due 2026-06-10). I'll assemble final acceptance spec and PR it to /product/specs.
Javier (Product): Small runbook snippet for inclusion:
```
# lite lane enforcement
1) Onboard check: context limiter (<=128) enabled
2) automated perf smoke (50 queries)
3) set soft-pin 21d in catalog metadata
4) if failing perf -> auto-promote to standard canary
```
Clara (CustomerOps): I'll also include customer contract language for enterprise negotiated pins.
ops-bot: Logged tasks: publish-eval-checklist assigned to Mei (due 2026-06-15); pin-runbook assigned to Ben (due 2026-06-12); migration-comm assigned to Clara (due 2026-06-10).
